answer: Split tally blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits at a reef vault and gets a split tally, half held, half sealed at a vertex. At each epoch zenith it shows both; an auditor matches the vertex record to the held half, and a mismatch burns the bond. A rented-half ring fails: one half serves one identity. Each fake pays 108, so 1,000 fakes cost 108,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 68,000 loss. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
